# AnisotropicTensileStrength

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The direction-dependent resistance of a crystalline material to tensile stress, reflecting its structural symmetry and bond anisotropy. Determines mechanical reliability of thin-film interconnects and device layers under directional stress in 3D integrated circuits.
